cards.card_text: The peacemakers The scribes The shepherds
cards.verse_text: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called sons of God.
cards.snippet: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called sons of God.

cards.card_text: What does he say peacemakers who sow in peace reap?
cards.verse_text: Peacemakers who sow in peace reap the fruit of righteousness.
cards.snippet: Peacemakers who sow in peace reap the fruit of righteousness.
